method: CPU-free, from committed original-only captures only.  The display scenario allocates bank/AffInit buffers before MissionLoad, so every allocation pointer moves.  Allocations are matched by their call sequence (the v1 record sequence of (caller return, size, flags) must be a subsequence of the display one); pointer words are then normalized: a dword whose v1 value points into a matched v1 allocation and whose display value is the same offset into its partner is a relocation, not a difference.  Everything else that differs is reported byte by byte, per state (MissionLoad entry and return, after load_tail, between_frames and frame1), with the first state where it appears. Unmatched display allocations (banks, surfaces' helpers) are listed as display-only blocks.
